sql:
SELECT
  l.ordered_on AS day,
  l.store_no AS store_no,
  l.item_no AS item_no,
  'total' AS series,
  l.sales_dollars AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE s.county_name = 'LINN'
  AND l.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no
    FROM sales.item i
    JOIN sales.item h ON h.item_no = i.family_item_no
    WHERE h.item_desc ILIKE '%FIREBALL%'
  )
  AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
assumptions: Fireball means all products whose family item description contains 'FIREBALL', including all sizes, flavors (e.g. Blazin Apple), and specialty packaging, sold under vendor Sazerac Company.
Linn County means stores whose county_name is LINN per sales.store.
Revenue means sales_dollars per order line.
Next quarter is counted from the first full quarter after the data ends (data through 2026-08-31), i.e. Q4 2026 (Oct-Dec 2026).
History included from 2016-01-01 onward for model training.
title: Fireball Revenue Forecast, Linn County, Next Quarter
product: Fireball (all Fireball-branded products: sizes, flavors, packs)

sql:
SELECT l.ordered_on AS day,
       l.store_no AS store_no,
       l.item_no AS item_no,
       'total' AS series,
       l.sales_bottles AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
WHERE l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
  AND l.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no
    FROM sales.item i
    JOIN sales.category c ON c.category_code = i.category_current
    WHERE c.category_name ILIKE '%VODKA%'
      AND c.category_name NOT ILIKE '%LIQUEUR%'
  )
assumptions: Vodka includes all vodka categories: Imported Vodkas, Imported Flavored Vodka, American Vodkas, American Flavored Vodka, Vodka 80 Proof, Other Proof Vodka; no liqueur or RTD vodka cocktail categories exist to exclude
Measure is bottles sold since not specified otherwise
No breakout requested, single total series
Default horizon of 6 months since not specified, starting September 2026 (first month after data ends August 31 2026)
Statewide (all Iowa stores) since no place was specified
title: Vodka demand forecast
product: Vodka (all categories: imported, american, flavored, other proof)
